name: Minimalist routine (gentle cleanser + moisturizer)

lead: A minimalist routine strips skincare down to a gentle cleanser and a moisturizer. People use it to avoid irritating the skin barrier and to get calmer, less breakout-prone skin.

General dermatology guidance recommends non-comedogenic, oil-free products, moisturizing even for oily acne-prone skin because barrier dysfunction may contribute to acne, and limiting washing to no more than twice daily. A fragrance-free moisturizer may reduce irritation, and in one cited study a ceramide cleanser and cream were well tolerated alongside acne medication and improved adherence.

paras: People wash morning and evening with a mild non-foaming or low-foaming cleanser and follow with a moisturizer, dropping harsher exfoliants and multi-step products. It is also used as a base while on acne medication. Calmer skin is typically noticed over a few weeks.
No specific risks are documented. The routine does not itself treat acne, so people with persistent breakouts often add treatment on top.

angle.text: Users strip their routine to a gentle cleanser and moisturizer to protect the skin barrier, so skin stays calmer and less irritated. The approach matches general dermatology guidance on the barrier and moisturizing.

lead: A minimalist routine strips skincare down to a gentle cleanser and a moisturizer, often to avoid damaging the skin barrier with harsher products.

Wikipedia reports that dermatologists recommend non-comedogenic, oil-free products, that washing more than twice daily is generally discouraged, and that people with acne, even oily skin, should moisturize because barrier dysfunction may contribute to acne. A fragrance-free moisturizer may reduce irritation, and in one cited study a ceramide cleanser and cream were well tolerated alongside acne medication and improved adherence [1].

paras: The recommendations above come from a general acne reference [1]; no trial of the minimalist routine as a whole was found.
No studies found for the routine as such. A study of a ceramide cleanser and cream used with acne drugs is cited in general acne references [1].
